reviews.decision_reason: The coverage output exactly maps the six capability needs to direct coverage and leaves the two non-matching input needs with missing-safe sentinels: empty capability_id and coverage=unsupported.

The declared behavior requires unsupported needs before covered needs, ordered by upstream provenance rank within each group. The produced priorities invert that behavior: covered records n06-r02 through n06-r08 are listed first and marked unsupported=true, while actually unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 are listed last and marked unsupported=false. This corrupts the ranked frontier used downstream.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group
preserve unsupported status consistently with coverage
